## Outcome

Describe what changed, why, and the observable result.

## Contract impact

Name the ontology, schema, graph, storage, sync, embedding, CLI, or Agent Skill
boundary affected. State `none` when persisted and exchanged bytes are
unchanged.

## Verification

- [ ] I added or updated focused regression evidence.
- [ ] I updated matching narrative and machine-readable specifications.
- [ ] `bun run check` passes.
- [ ] The check leaves the generated tree unchanged.
